==== src/VerifySample.Tests/ModuleInitializer.cs

// Generated by the Verify wizard: https://verifytests.github.io/Wizard/new?step=output&os=Windows&ide=Rider&cli=Cli&tf=XunitV3&ci=GitHubActions&ext=Sylvan&sponsor=Exempt&exempt=OpenSource&until=2027-09
// Delete whatever is not needed.
using System.Runtime.CompilerServices;

// Everything here runs once, when the test assembly loads, before any test.
public static class ModuleInitializer
{
    [ModuleInitializer]
    public static void Initialize()
    {
        // Initializes every Verify.* plugin the project references and has not initialized above.
        // Explicit calls come first so their parameters apply: a plugin can only be initialized once.
        VerifierSettings.InitializePlugins();
    }
}

==== src/VerifySample.Tests/Extensions/SylvanTests.cs

// Generated by the Verify wizard: https://verifytests.github.io/Wizard/new?step=output&os=Windows&ide=Rider&cli=Cli&tf=XunitV3&ci=GitHubActions&ext=Sylvan&sponsor=Exempt&exempt=OpenSource&until=2027-09
// Delete whatever is not needed.
using Sylvan.Data.Csv;
using Sylvan.Data.Excel;

// Verify.Sylvan.Data.Excel: Verifies xls, xlsb and xlsx workbooks by converting each sheet to csv, with no Office install and no licence.
// https://github.com/VerifyTests/Verify.Sylvan.Data.Excel
// Note: The samples need a workbook of your own: add it to the test project with
// <CopyToOutputDirectory>PreserveNewest</CopyToOutputDirectory> and drop the skip attribute.
// Note: A workbook with one sheet produces a single unnamed csv target; several sheets produce one
// target per sheet, named after the worksheet.
// Note: An info object listing the sheet names is always written beside the csv targets.
// Note: CsvDataWriterOptions throws unless NewLine is \n, so snapshots stay identical across
// operating systems.
// Note: ExcelDataReaderOptions configures the reading side and is in the source but not in the
// readme.
// Note: Stream converters are registered for xls, xlsb and xlsx.
// Note: Pure managed and cross platform: unlike Verify.Syncfusion there is no licence and no
// native dependency.
public class SylvanTests
{
    // The workbook is converted to csv before it is compared, so a snapshot diff shows the cell
    // values that changed rather than a binary file that differs everywhere.
    // Not run by default: needs a sample.xlsx of your own beside the test, copied to the output
    // directory.
    [Fact(Skip = "needs a sample.xlsx of your own beside the test, copied to the output directory.")]
    public Task ExcelFile()
    {
        return VerifyFile("sample.xlsx");
    }

    // Code that builds a workbook in memory has a stream rather than a file. The extension
    // passed to Verify is what picks the converter, so it has to be given explicitly.
    // Not run by default: needs a sample.xlsx of your own beside the test, copied to the output
    // directory.
    [Fact(Skip = "needs a sample.xlsx of your own beside the test, copied to the output directory.")]
    public async Task ExcelStream()
    {
        await using var stream = File.OpenRead("sample.xlsx");

        await Verify(stream, "xlsx");
    }

    // A reader can be verified directly, which is what code already reading a workbook has,
    // and it names the workbook type rather than inferring it from an extension.
    // Not run by default: needs a sample.xlsx of your own beside the test, copied to the output
    // directory.
    [Fact(Skip = "needs a sample.xlsx of your own beside the test, copied to the output directory.")]
    public async Task ExcelReader()
    {
        await using var stream = File.OpenRead("sample.xlsx");
        using var reader = ExcelDataReader.Create(stream, ExcelWorkbookType.ExcelXml);

        await Verify(reader);
    }

    // Cell values holding commas make a comma separated snapshot hard to read. A tab delimiter
    // keeps the columns lined up. NewLine has to stay \n or the call throws.
    // Not run by default: needs a sample.xlsx of your own beside the test, copied to the output
    // directory.
    [Fact(Skip = "needs a sample.xlsx of your own beside the test, copied to the output directory.")]
    public async Task WriterOptions()
    {
        await using var stream = File.OpenRead("sample.xlsx");
        var options = new CsvDataWriterOptions
        {
            Delimiter = '\t'
        };

        await Verify(stream, "xlsx")
            .CsvDataWriterOptions(options);
    }
}
